title: Case Series Investigating the Efficacy and Safety of Bilateral Fluocinolone Acetonide (ILUVIEN®) in Patients with Diabetic Macular Edema: 10 Eyes with 12 Months Follow-up

groups.agent: fluocinolone acetonide implant 0.2 ug/day (ILUVIEN), one implant per eye
groups.description: Both eyes of five pseudophakic patients with bilateral chronic DME, previously treated with macular laser and anti-VEGF injections (most also triamcinolone)

exclusions.what: Visual acuity, ETDRS letters, at baseline and change at 6 and 12 months (Table 2, Tab2!R2C2-C4)
exclusions.reason: The row is labelled visual acuity and the article never states that the acuity is best-corrected or measured at the ETDRS protocol refraction (protocol inclusion 1).
Shown only in a figure; the article's tables have no per-eye acuity rows, and supplementary material is not acquired.

notes: Table 1 gives per-eye demographics and prior treatments only, without acuity.
Prior treatment: previously treated; regimen: single implant per eye.
Central retinal thickness and intraocular pressure are not extracted.
